snippet.title: Silktrails: Cats in the Grove // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623120/Silktrails_Cats_in_the_grove

Embark on Silktrails, a cozy, hand-drawn adventure from the world of "Silkgrove". Explore cozy landscapes and discover hidden cats in a beautifully illustrated world. Join the quest to find these elusive companions.

@gallicentertainment
